violation_type.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.801(6))
violation_type.short_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations
violation_type.typical_finding: Two cats and two dogs do not have up to date vaccinations.

finding_variants.text: Two cats and two dogs do not have up to date vaccinations.
There was one pet in the home that did not have any vet health statements or vaccines available for review when requested.
There was one dog present without documentation of vaccination records.
There is one dog kept in the home for which the primary giver has no vaccine or veterinary records.
Current shot records are needed for the dog in the home.
The provider did not copies of pet vaccination records for two dogs in care.
